<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=I Am Allergic|id=A0096}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Not only do we learn how to say that we are allergic, but JP also tells us about all the things that we could be allergic to. Although Liliana finds it hard to believe. The keyword is '''alérgico''' – allergic.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0106|A0106: Room service]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0116|A0116: Do you want a mint?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0131|A0131: I miss them]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Quiero el pastel de chocolate.'''
| I want the chocolate cake.
| '''Está bien.'''
| That's fine.
| '''¿El pastel tiene nueces?'''
| Does the cake have nuts?
| '''No, no tiene.'''
| No, it doesn't have any.
| '''¿Segura? Porque soy alérgico.'''
| Are you sure? Because I am allergic.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Quiero el pastel de chocolate.'''
| I want the chocolate cake.
| '''Está bien.'''
| That's fine.
| '''¿El pastel tiene nueces?'''
| Does the cake have nuts?
| '''No, no tiene.'''
| No, it doesn't have any.
| '''¿Segura? Porque soy alérgico.'''
| Are you sure? Because I am allergic.
}}</includeonly>

Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.

| I want the chocolate cake.
| '''Quiero el pastel de chocolate.'''
| That's fine.
| '''Está bien.'''
| Does the cake have nuts?
| '''¿El pastel tiene nueces?'''

| '''No, no tiene.'''
| Are you sure? Because I am allergic.
| '''¿Segura? Porque soy alérgico.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| I want the three cream cake.
| '''Quiero el pastel de tres leches.'''
| That's fine.
| '''Está bien.'''
| Does the cake have carrot?
| '''¿El pastel tiene zanahoria?'''
| No, it doesn't have any. It has apple.
| '''No, no tiene. Tiene manzana.'''
| No! I'm allergic to ({{=}} '''a''') the apples.
| '''¡No! Soy alérgico a las manzanas.'''
| The apple cake has no apple.
| '''El pastel de manzana no tiene manzana.'''
| Are you sure? The apple cake has no apple?
| '''¿Segura? ¿El pastel de manzana no tiene manzana?'''
| It has no apple. The three cream cake has apple.
| '''No tiene manzana. El pastel de tres leches tiene manzana.'''
| Fine.
| '''Bien.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| I want the three cream cake.
| '''Quiero el pastel de tres leches.'''
| That's fine.
| '''Está bien.'''
| Does the cake have carrot?
| '''¿El pastel tiene zanahoria?'''
| No, it doesn't have any. It has apple.
| '''No, no tiene. Tiene manzana.'''
| No! I'm allergic to ({{=}} '''a''') the apples.
| '''¡No! Soy alérgico a las manzanas.'''
| The apple cake has no apple.
| '''El pastel de manzana no tiene manzana.'''
| Are you sure? The apple cake has no apple?
| '''¿Segura? ¿El pastel de manzana no tiene manzana?'''
| It has no apple. The three cream cake has apple.
| '''No tiene manzana. El pastel de tres leches tiene manzana.'''
| Fine.
| '''Bien.'''
}}</includeonly>
